verdict.rationale: A live probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document downloadable at https://proa.so/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), which literally satisfies the story. Nothing in the evidence explains what API surface the spec covers or how complete it is. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the OpenAPI spec and its scope, evidence of spec completeness/versioning, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a single probe.
